questions.question:
**In the following question, some part of the sentence may have errors. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate option. If a sentence is free from error, select 'No Error'.** 

According to the Copernican principle, the Earth does not (1)/ occupy a unique position in the Universe while (2)/ implies life on other planets can be a possibility. (3)/ No error (4)
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

Reading the above sentence we find that: 

 
• The word **while **is incorrectly used. 
 
• **While **is a noun that means a period of time. 
 
• It can also be used as a **conjunction** and as an **adverb **with the same meaning. 
 
• Instead, we should use a **pronoun **that is used to** refer to something previously mentioned. **
 
• **Which **is a pronoun that is used to refer to something previously mentioned. 
 
• Thus from the above points we can conclude that the error lies in part **2 **of the sentence. 

The correct sentence will be: *According to the Copernican principle, the Earth does not occupy a unique position in the Universe **which** implies life on other plants can be a possibility. *

questions.question: The average height of A, B and C is 148 cm. If the average height of A and B is 136 cm and that of B and C is 125 cm, then what is the height (in cm) of B?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average height of A & B = 136

Average height of B & C = 125

**Formula used:**

Average = Sum of observation &div
ide; no. of observation

**Calculation:**

A + B + C = 148 × 3 = 444 ----(1)

A + B = 136 × 2 = 272 ----(2)

B + C = 125 × 2 = 250 ----(3)

Subtract equation (2) from equation (1)

A + B + C – A – B = 444 – 272

⇒ C = 172

Putting value of C in equation (3), we get

B + 172 = 250

**∴ B = 250 – 172 = 78 cm**

questions.question: The agricultural price support program is an example of _________.
questions.solution:
A price ceiling

 
 
 
It is a situation when the price charged is more than or less than the equilibrium price by market.

 
 
 

 
 
A price floor

 
 
 
A price floor is the lowest legal price that can be sold commonly. It is used by the government to prevent prices from being too low.

 
 
 

 
 
Equilibrium pricing

 
 
 
It is the market price where the quantity of goods supplies is equal to the number of goods in demand.

 
 
 

 

So, the agricultural price support program is an example of a price floor.

questions.question: Water covers _______% of the Earth’s surface.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 2 i.e __**70 %**__

About **75%** of the Earth’s surface is water-covered and the oceans hold for about 96.5% of all Earth’s water.

Water also exists in the air as water vapour in rivers and lakes, icecaps and glaciers and in the ground as soil moisture.

 
 

 Components
 Important information
 
 

 Lithosphere
 
 
It is the outer part of the Earth and other celestial bodies. It covers the rocky part of the body. On Earth, it is considered as the crust and the rigid upper mantle part.

 
 
 

 Hydrosphere
 It is the component of the Earth which covers about 70% of the surface. It includes the oceans, seas, lakes, ponds, rivers, and streams. 
 
 

 Biosphere
 It is the ecosystem that contains all the living beings and their relationship with nature. The term "Biosphere" was coined by geologist Eduard Suess in 1875. 
 
 

 Atmosphere
 It is kind of a blanket that contains gases and surrounds the Earth from outside. Where we live, we breathe, we act and we do daily activities are all part of the atmosphere.

questions.question: ________ among the following is not an operating system.
questions.solution:
• **Mozilla Firefox **is not an operating system.
 
• Mozilla Firefox is a **free open-source web browser **developed by Mozilla Foundation. Firefox is available for Windows, macOS, Linux and BSD operating systems.
 
• A web browser is a **software application** for accessing the information on the World Wide Web.
